definitions.gloss: continued rise; further advance; continued gain
definitions.explanation: A continued upward movement, especially in stock prices, market indexes, or other numerical measures. Used primarily in financial and economic reporting.

examples.japanese: {株価|かぶか}が{続伸|ぞくしん}した。
{日経|にっけい}{平均|へいきん}は3{日|にち}{連続|れんぞく}で{続伸|ぞくしん}している。
examples.english: The Nikkei average has risen for three consecutive days.

examples.japanese: {好決算|こうけっさん}を{受|う}けて、{同社|どうしゃ}の{株|かぶ}は{大幅|おおはば}に{続伸|ぞくしん}し、{年初|ねんしょ}{来高値|らいたかね}を{更新|こうしん}した。
examples.english: Following strong earnings, the company's stock continued to advance sharply, reaching a new high for the year.

notes: Functions as a する verb: {続伸|ぞくしん}する (to continue rising). A financial journalism term. Compound: {続|ぞく} (continue) + {伸|しん} (extend/grow). The opposite is {続落|ぞくらく} (continued decline). Appears in headlines and financial news, e.g., 「{日経|にっけい}{平均|へいきん}、{続伸|ぞくしん}」(Nikkei average continues to rise). Related: {続落|ぞくらく} (continued fall), {反発|はんぱつ} (rebound), {反落|はんらく} (pullback).
